title: Norway's constitution binds the King to grant a resignation after a Storting vote of no confidence
summary: Norway's constitution binds the King to grant a resignation after a Storting vote of no confidence.
body: Article 15 says any person who holds a seat in the Council of State must submit a resignation once the Storting has passed a vote of no confidence against that member or against the Council as a whole, and that the King is bound to grant the resignation. The source says: "orting has passed a vote of no confidence against that Member of the Council of State or against the Council of State as a whole." The text states a duty to resign and a duty on the King to accept it. It is the written rule, not a count of how often the vote is used.
